evaluation_protocol.review_unit: Per claim plus final summary completeness; do not require exact wording or evidence ID strings.
evaluation_protocol.warning: These are expected results, not observed live-model outputs. Synthetic authored statements are not scientific ground truth.

cases.purpose: Separate support, familiarity, uncertainty and barriers; optionally test information exposure.

answers.concept: I have heard the word, but I do not know what a drone is.
answers.delivery: I have not heard about drones carrying goods before today.
answers.understanding: I like the idea of deliveries by drone, but I cannot explain what difference they would make.
answers.experience: Before this session, I had not attended a drone event or taken part in any activity about delivery drones.
answers.needs: I would like to know how they carry goods and what happens if a delivery cannot be completed.
answers.opportunity: I would be interested in a discussion, but I have never been invited and do not know where to find one.

probes.scope: These statements concern different activities. Please keep the experiences separate; I am not reporting independent verification.
probes.reasoning: I am unsure. I cannot explain an effect yet.
probes.contribution: I have not taken part in an activity about drones.
probes.domain: I am not reporting an earlier activity.
probes.influence: I have not made a contribution, so I cannot report an outcome.

must_capture: Familiarity is self-reported recognition of a term, not demonstrated understanding.
Concept and delivery knowledge are explicitly unknown/absent before optional information.
Explicit absence of prior drone activity.
Information needs: carrying goods and unsuccessful deliveries.
Willingness to discuss; never invited and unknown access are participation barriers.
must_not_infer: A readiness level or numerical score from support.

optional_variant.action: At the concept question explicitly select Show definition, then answer concept with the following text. Run separately from the no-information baseline.
optional_variant.answer: From the definition you just showed me, a drone is an aircraft with no pilot on board. I did not know that before this interview.
expected: Preserve the earlier familiarity answer and pre-information snapshot.
Record exact definition/version/time; later evidence is after_information.
The repeated definition must not establish independent prior knowledge or an automatic learning/readiness gain.

cases.answer_policy: Use an answer only when its question ID is actually asked. Confirm only a faithful interpretation; log misses before correcting. Do not paste the entire case into one answer.

cases.purpose: Capture causal reasoning and transferable contribution without inventing drone attendance or influence.

answers.concept: A drone is an aircraft without a pilot sitting inside it.
answers.delivery: I have heard of drones carrying parcels and medical samples. I understand that avoiding road traffic is one reason people consider them.
answers.understanding: I am cautious about deliveries near homes. Repeated flights could disturb sleep because the sound may interrupt people who rest during the day. Faster transport might help urgent deliveries, but I do not know whether that would happen locally.
answers.experience: Last year I attended a public bus-route consultation and suggested moving a stop closer to a clinic. That was about buses, not drones. I have never attended a drone consultation. I would attend one if I could.
answers.needs: I would want measured sound at homes and evidence about delivery times before forming a view about a local service.
answers.opportunity: I do not know where to submit comments about delivery drones. Caring responsibilities make evening meetings difficult; an online option would help.

probes.scope: These statements concern different activities. Please keep the experiences separate; I am not reporting independent verification.
probes.reasoning: The sound could interrupt sleep when flights happen during resting hours; actual disturbance would need measurements.
probes.contribution: At the bus consultation I suggested moving a stop closer to a clinic.
probes.domain: The consultation was about buses, not drones.
probes.influence: I do not know whether my suggestion changed the bus-route decision.

must_capture: Everyday drone concept and delivery-use knowledge, separately from impact reasoning.
Causal sleep/noise reasoning and conditional possible delivery benefit, not verified local facts.
Actual self-reported bus consultation contribution in a transferable domain.
Explicit absence of drone consultation; willingness to attend remains intention.
Unknown influence after the outcome answer.
Both evidence needs: sound and delivery times.
Unknown feedback route, caring barrier, and requested online opportunity.
Healthcare sector does not change the personal claim subject.
Academic category changes neither personal wording nor evidence sufficiency.
must_not_infer: Actual drone consultation or verified influence.
A contradiction between bus participation and no drone consultation.
Equity, infrastructure, airspace expertise or organisation capability from clinic references.
A medical-corridor acceptance assessment or readiness penalty for caution.

correction_variant.action: After completing the baseline, edit the experience answer using Edit your details or an earlier answer.
correction_variant.answer: Last year I listened to a public bus-route consultation. I did not speak or submit a suggestion. I have never attended a drone consultation.

cases.purpose: Organisational planning contribution and unknown influence; no ORL inference.

answers.concept: A drone is an aircraft with no pilot on board; it can be remotely controlled or use automated systems.
answers.delivery: I have heard of parcel delivery and transporting medical materials. I do not know which services operate in this region.
answers.understanding: Deliveries could avoid some road journeys if they replace road vehicle journeys. They might also create extra trips instead, so the overall traffic effect would depend on what they replace.
answers.experience: Our planning team reviewed delivery-drone options this year and submitted comments requesting evidence about which road journeys could be replaced. I drafted the comments as part of the team. We do not know whether any decision changed because of our comments.
answers.needs: Our team would like evidence about which road journeys deliveries would replace and what responsibilities a local authority would have.
answers.opportunity: For our team, a clearly advertised consultation and an accessible way to send written comments would help. I do not know of an existing local channel.

probes.scope: I drafted the comments this year as part of our planning team. The review and submission were organisational activities.
probes.reasoning: Replacing road vehicle journeys could reduce road journeys, but adding deliveries without replacing trips would not do that.
probes.contribution: I drafted our team comments requesting evidence about replaced road journeys.
probes.domain: Our review and comments concerned delivery drones.
probes.influence: We do not know whether our comments changed any decision.

must_capture: Self-reported team planning review and submission, separately from the respondent drafting comments.
Actual IAM contribution, not an operational drone trial or a completed organisational audit.
Unknown influence, not explicit absence or verified effect.
Conditional traffic reasoning and organisational information/participation needs.
must_not_infer: Verified influence or operational drone experience.
Numerical ORL, CRL, TRL or SRL.
Personal drafting as proof of all organisational capability.
